## 1. Import Data

Dataset is imported into R and given descriptive names

```{r}
# Data imported
data <- read.csv("iris.data", header = FALSE)

# Naming VAR
names(data) <- c("SepalLength", "SepalWidth", "PetalLength", "PetalWidth", "Species")

# Showing the first 5 rows
head(data, 5)
```

## 2. Descriptive Statistics

Summary of descriptive statistics for the VAR

```{r}
summary(data$SepalLength)
summary(data$SepalWidth)
summary(data$PetalLength)
summary(data$PetalWidth)
summary(data$Species)
```
Shows number of observations for each species of iris
```{r}
table(data$Species)
```

## 3. VAR Transformation

"Species" VAR is turned into a categorical factor
```{r}

data$Species <- as.factor(data$Species)

data$Species

```
## 4. Histogram

Histogram shows the distribution of Sepal Length in the observation
```{r}
hist(data$SepalLength,
     main = "Distri. of Sepal Length",
     xlab = "Sepal Length")
```

## 5. Scatterplot

Scatterplot shows relationship between Sepal Width and Petal Width
```{r}
plot(data$SepalWidth,
     data$PetalWidth,
     main = "Sepal Width vs. Petal Width",
     xlab = "Sepal Width",
     ylab = "Petal Width")
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```
